reason: Repeated equal Actions read/parse work is material, but equality at publication is not equivalence of live-file notifications. The variant carries no immutable snapshot/version; collapsing reads can suppress intervening invalid/missing-state diagnostics, last-good/recovery transitions, versions and dependent-action ordering. All33variant matrix establishes no safe transport whitelist. Cost alone does not satisfy the semantic half of the trigger.

Existing domain request reducers and equal-publication reuse retained
No new coalescing slots/markers/accounting state or worker

No claim every future notification is inherently uncoalescible
